spec.title: Successful validations/s
spec.description: Current successful validation rate by chain.

spec.title: Validation p95
spec.description: Time to a ready decision for 95% of successfully validated candidates.

spec.title: Collation p95
spec.description: End-to-end successful candidate build duration at the 95th percentile.

spec.title: Rejected
spec.description: Number of rejected validation results for masterchain over the selected dashboard range. Zero is healthy.

spec.title: Errors
spec.description: Number of error validation results for masterchain over the selected dashboard range. Zero is healthy.

spec.title: Deadlines
spec.description: Number of deadline validation results for masterchain over the selected dashboard range. Zero is healthy.

spec.title: Validation: full path
spec.description: Mean duration of one validation split into non-overlapping stages. The stack height is the typical end-to-end time; p95 is shown in the health cards.

spec.title: Semantic validation
spec.description: Breakdown of semantic_validation. Input waiting is separated from deterministic work.

spec.title: Successful validations
spec.description: Successful decision rate by chain.

spec.title: Unsuccessful validations
spec.description: Failures only, excluding success. Results are stacked by outcome.

spec.title: Validation candidate size p95
spec.description: P95 over exact sizes sampled from the latest candidate entering validation. Block and collated data are separated; if multiple candidates arrive between Prometheus scrapes, only the latest one is visible.

spec.title: Finalized slots
spec.description: Consensus progress rate by chain. A sustained zero during an active session needs investigation.

spec.title: Consensus certificates
spec.description: Certificates by kind. Rising skip certificates while finalization stays flat indicate slots without a block.

spec.title: Consensus votes
spec.description: Local voting decisions stacked by outcome.

spec.title: Candidate cache
spec.description: Retained entries keep their payload; released entries keep metadata only. The additional line shows payloads actually retained.

spec.title: Cache memory and budget
spec.description: Actual candidate cache bytes compared with the published retention budget.

spec.title: Collation stages
spec.description: Mean candidate time by non-overlapping stage. Candidate assembly is split into state preparation, queue cleanup, message execution, account finalization, state-update construction, serialization, and final bookkeeping.

spec.title: Collation pipeline split (mean)
spec.description: Mean additive partition of one shard candidate build. Orange is exclusive stage time before the early-successor handoff fence, while the next build is still blocked. Green is serialize_candidate plus finalize_candidate after the fence and may overlap the successor. The stack height is the mean BuildCandidate duration. block_boc is a nested concurrent substage and is intentionally not added; percentiles are not additive and are intentionally not stacked.

spec.title: Block throughput
spec.description: Produced blocks/s uses recently completed local leader windows: successfully delivered candidates divided by their combined actual window time, so idle time is excluded. It is emitted only when Prometheus observes a window completion and is zero otherwise; its timestamp is bounded by the 15 s scrape interval. Validated blocks/s remains the normal rolling validation throughput.

spec.title: Build problems
spec.description: Build results excluding success and not_ready. Not_ready is normal input waiting and is not mixed with failures.

spec.title: Candidate delivery p95
spec.description: Time from a ready candidate through persist, commit, scheduling, and publication.

spec.title: Outbound queue size p95
spec.description: 95th-percentile outbound queue size after producing a masterchain candidate.

spec.title: Produced candidate size p95
spec.description: 95th percentile of exact block and collated-data gauge samples for locally produced masterchain candidates.

spec.title: Latest produced block contents (exact)
spec.description: Exact contents of the latest masterchain candidate produced by this node. External messages are stacked with internal and tick-tock transactions; the separate total-transactions series is intentionally omitted. Each scraped value is exact; when multiple candidates are produced between Prometheus scrapes, only the latest one is visible.

spec.title: Schedule lateness p95
spec.description: Positive schedule lateness. Shardchain build_start excludes the first slot of each window and shows only carry-over between sequential candidates; masterchain build_start and broadcast include every slot.

spec.title: Deadlines and pressure
spec.description: Rare decisions explaining empty blocks, waiting, and overload. All stacked series use events per second.

spec.title: Out-queue cleanup
spec.description: Cleanup stop reasons. Rising budget means the wall-clock budget is binding; block_full means the block limit is binding.

spec.title: Operator-actionable errors
spec.description: Any non-zero value is abnormal: spec rejection, self-rejection, persistence failure, backstop, or producer alarm.
